topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture's scope and introduces the upcoming discussion on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate recognition of pathogens and tissue damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects microbes and cellular damage through pattern recognition receptors and downstream signaling cascades.

topics.label: Cellular activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct leukocyte trafficking into tissues, initiate lymphatic drainage, and drive systemic inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the immune response shuts down active inflammation, restores injured tissue architecture, and walls off persistent pathogens in chronic states.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the presentation and announces the topic of the next lecture.
